title: Member ID Card Terms, Prairie Ridge Categories
content:
Terms for the member ID card of the Medicaid Managed Care Membership, by eligibility category: how many physical replacements are mailed for loss, theft or damage in a rolling 365-day window, how long a mailed card takes, and which other forms of proof of coverage exist.

## Card terms by eligibility category

| Category | Physical replacements for loss, theft or damage in a rolling 365-day window | Mailed card produced and posted within (business days) | Digital ID card in the member portal and app | Temporary proof-of-coverage letter while a physical card is in the mail |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult | 3 | 7 | Available | Available |
| Prairie Ridge Family Care | 3 | 7 | Available | Available |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | 3 | 7 | Available | Available |
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | 3 | 7 | Available | Available |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 3 | 7 | Available | Available |
| Prairie Ridge ABD Care | 4 | 5 | Available | Available |
| Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | 4 | 5 | Available | Available |

## Notes

- **Business days** are Monday to Friday, excluding state holidays.
- **Replacement count.** The count is of physical cards issued for loss, theft or damage within a rolling window of 365 calendar days: 4 in Prairie Ridge ABD Care and Prairie Ridge Dual Complete, 3 in every other category.
- **Production time.** A mailed card is produced and posted within 5 business days in Prairie Ridge ABD Care and Prairie Ridge Dual Complete and within 7 business days in every other category.

## Hypothetical reading

*Hypothetically*, a Prairie Ridge ABD Care member whose rolling 365-day window already holds 3 mailed replacements for loss, theft or damage is still below that category's figure of 4, while a Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids member with the same 3 has reached that category's figure of 3.
